summary: Frontend E2E flow fully verified after AsyncStorage 2.2.0 fix. All 5 requested scenarios PASS: (1) Home → optimise-btn navigates to /loading with dark Swiss counter 01/06 and rotating stages, auto-redirects to /results in ~3s; (2) /results renders exactly 3 trip cards (Cheapest £375, Best Value £376, Lowest Risk) with rank pills, hero price, flight + hotel rows, and BOOK NOW · 78% CONFIDENCE badge; (3) Tapping cheapest card opens /trip/[id] with full breakdown, price-sparkline (history + forecast + 'now £375'), sticky Book flight / Book hotel buttons; (4) save-trip-btn POST /api/trips/save succeeds and trip appears on /saved as 'Bristol → Palma de Mallorca £375'; (5) Trash icon on /saved deletes the row (1 → 0). No console errors, no red-screen, AsyncStorage error from iteration_1 is gone.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from the shimmer Animated.View on /loading. Cosmetic only — does not break the flow.

action_items: Optional: replace `pointerEvents="none"` with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` on the Animated.View shimmer in /app/frontend/app/loading.tsx (line 82) to silence the deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: src/store.ts still has no web-platform fallback for AsyncStorage; works now because the version is pinned to 2.2.0 by Expo, but a thin Platform.OS==='web' wrapper using localStorage would future-proof against another version drift.
Three screens (results.tsx, saved.tsx, trip/[id].tsx) hard-code the literal key 'tripopt:active_trip'. Move to a shared constant in src/store.ts to avoid drift.
seed_data_creation: One trip saved during the test then deleted in the same run — clean state on exit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full TripOpt MVP flow is green on web preview at mobile viewport 390x844: search → loading → results (3 ranked cards) → trip detail (sparkline + sticky book buttons + save) → saved list → delete. AsyncStorage is now 2.2.0 (Expo-compatible). Backend already 8/8 in iteration_1. Only minor item left is the pointerEvents deprecation warning on loading.tsx.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 1 blocker (AsyncStorage.default.multiSet undefined on web) was caused by package.json pinning ^3.0.2 against an Expo SDK that expected 2.2.0. Main agent ran `npx expo install @react-native-async-storage/async-storage` which downgraded to 2.2.0 and restarted Expo. Verified resolved: persistResults now succeeds, /loading is reached, full flow completes.
